title: Effective Configuration
prompt:
Resolve the effective configuration for eight keys using these rules:
1. An environment entry with lock=true governs immediately.
2. Otherwise a service entry with lock=true governs immediately.
3. Otherwise choose the highest-precedence non-INHERIT value in runtime > service > environment > base.
4. Missing entries behave like INHERIT.
5. If all normal layers are missing or INHERIT, use fallback.
6. The literal value "off" is a real value, not absence or INHERIT.

Frozen layers (base, environment, env_lock, service, service_lock, runtime, fallback):
mode: stable, balanced, false, fast, true, turbo, missing
quota: 4, 6, true, 8, false, 10, missing
route: blue, green, false, red, false, gold, missing
audit: standard, verbose, false, INHERIT, false, minimal, missing
cache: on, INHERIT, false, off, false, INHERIT, missing
window: narrow, wide, false, INHERIT, false, INHERIT, missing
feature: on, off, false, on, false, off, missing
channel: missing, INHERIT, false, INHERIT, false, INHERIT, backup

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"configuration":{"mode":{"value":"fast","layer":"SERVICE"}, ...}}}
Include exactly mode, quota, route, audit, cache, window, feature, and channel. Use layer names BASE, ENV, SERVICE, RUNTIME, or FALLBACK.
